messages:
Maria_CS: Quick heads-up — we want to pilot a consolidated "Office Hours Hub" next week to reduce duplicate drop-ins and make it easier to route renewal-risk accounts into focused slots. Thinking Mon–Fri block with regional handoffs. Who can volunteer for recurring slots? Reply with the days/times you can cover (PT preferred) and whether you can take priority (renewal-risk) queues.

Sam_Enable: I can take Tue + Thu 1–4pm PT (that's EMEA morning). Happy to take priority slots on those days if needed.

Jordan_SE: I can cover APAC mornings (Mon/Wed 6–9am PT). We should use one shared booking link + a short prework survey so we can triage ahead of time.

Ashley_Ops: I'll build the booking sheet and a rotation spreadsheet. Proposal: 30min slots by default, add a 60min "priority" slot block for renewal-risk accounts. Also drafting a standard agenda template so we capture consistent notes/next steps.

Maria_CS: Agenda template (please copy into session note doc):
```
Title: Office Hours Hub — <Customer / Topic>
Duration: 30m (change to 60m for priority)
Facilitators: <names>
Customer timezone: <tz>
Purpose: quick triage / troubleshooting / next-steps
Top 3 topics requested:
- 
- 
- 
Action items & owner:
- 
Notes link: <drive doc url>
Feedback form: https://forms.gle/ri-office-feedback
```

Sam_Enable: Nice template. For the booking link — can we have a "priority reason" field so SEs can mark renewal/exec escalations? Also can we add a calendar event template snippet for invites?

Jordan_SE: +1 to priority field. Calendar snippet (paste into invite body):
```
Office Hours Hub — <Customer>
Join: <meet link>
Agenda: quick triage, 10m discovery, 15m demo/steps, 5m next-actions
Notes doc: <drive link>
If this is a renewal-risk account, mark X in the booking form and tag @maria_cs
```

deploy-bot: :bell: Calendar event created for "Office Hours Hub (pilot)" Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 PT — shared booking link: https://bit.ly/ri-officehub (auto-generated)

Ashley_Ops: Uploaded rotation sheet and provisional slots here: https://bit.ly/ri-office-schedule
I've pre-marked Tue/Thu 13:00–16:00 PT for Sam, Mon/Wed 06:00–09:00 PT for Jordan. Need someone for Fri coverage 12:00–16:00 PT (half-day). Also flagged one customer — "Avery Health" — as renewal-risk; suggest we reserve a 60m priority slot Tue 14:00 PT for them. Can someone take that?

Sam_Enable: I can take the Avery Health 14:00 PT 60m slot. I'll prep a short pre-read and send the invite.

Jordan_SE: I'll claim Fri 12:00–16:00 PT rotation on a trial basis — can pair with Sam for handoffs if Avery spills over.

Maria_CS: Awesome — please reply YES to confirm your assigned slots so I can finalize. Quick ask: after each session drop the notes link and paste the feedback form summary (1–2 bullets) into the rotation sheet so we can track quality regressions.

Jordan_SE: YES — will paste notes + one-line feedback.

Ashley_Ops: YES, updating the schedule and CS playbook checklist now. I'll add a tiny automation to copy completed session rows to the weekly recap.

Maria_CS: Thanks all. I'll publish the pilot schedule in #customer-success and ping people for coverage reminders. If anyone else wants recurring slots, add your name to the spreadsheet. Tagging @people-ops for facilitator credit & @sales-eng for FYI on renewal-risk handling.

Sam_Enable: :thumbsup: See you in the hub. Let's try a two-week pilot and iterate.
